title: scrollback does not work while using codex in a pane
body:
2. Issues with the Zellij UI / behavior / crash

```
❯ zellij --version
zellij 0.43.1
```

I have replicated this across multiple systems (macos sequoia) using ghostty as the terminal. 

## Minimal reproduction

launch `codex` then ask it to perform actions. Once it is done, attempt to scroll back. Other panes in the session scroll back fine, if exit codex, then that pane can scroll as well.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: even when using search, where it opens the edit scrollback - no additional content is shown:

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hello,

I am not an expert here but I want to share the discussion that happen on discord on the subject:

LH talked about this issue and got the following reply https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/2558#issuecomment-3228924264
> In that case - and with the strong disclaimer that I have not tried to reproduce this myself and this is just an educated guess - this happens because the application is relying on the scrollbuffer in "Alternate Screen" (eg. with control code 1049), which the specification mentions should not exist (source: https://invisible-island.net/xterm/ctlseqs/ctlseqs.html under "Alternate Screen Buffer").
>
> I have tried in the past to be lenient with this behavior, because this is a common issue with some apps (can't blame them, not everyone spends time reading xterm specs), but allowing scrollbuffer in these cases causes a lot of other problems in apps that do follow the spec. Feel free to quote me on this.

participant11 later added:
> Might still be the same. Hard to know without seeing an ANSI dump - in any case though, I'm guessing this is a problematic or inaccurate behavior on the app's part given that the commenters in that issue indicate this happens to them in other terminals as well.
> Again - just a guess. If one of their engineers would like to point out a specific ANSI sequence that Zellij treats wrongly given a spec or a commonality among terminal emulators, I'd be happy to take a look.

Right now I see the issue seems to talk about new PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/2558#issuecomment-3693041018 (from a very quick look at the PR's comment, it may not be accepted as is?)

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Yeah, I would love this to be fixed, facing the same issue. I'm on a Mac using Ghostty Terminal with Zellij & Fish Shell fwiw.

This also doesn't work in OpenCode at times. I would love to scroll to see the output AI changes, and this makes it really unusable. 

The PR link has this as solution, I'll test it:

### ~/.codex/config.toml

```toml
[tui]
alternate_screen = "never"
```

comments.body: I'm just guessing, but I'd imagine it's because these apps use TUI frameworks that totally redraw the screen, rather than dumping a screen's worth of text everytime. So you can't scrollback through the history, because nothing is being added to the history.

I've also encountered the issue where Codex (the scrollback buffer) cannot scroll, but it doesn't happen every time.

I experienced this when using a left-right split layout. However, if I resize the pane width at that moment, scrolling starts working again. If I resize the pane back to half-screen width, the scrolling breaks again.
